name: Chrome Dome Head Gear Minefield
description:
The Chrome Dome was designed to make hostile environments manageable. This unique head gear features a lightweight and reflective hat with a sloped brim, goggles that automatically adjust to lighting conditions, large ear flaps, and a neck gaiter to cover the face. Whether trudging through snow or sand, the Chrome Dome is ready to brave the elements with you.

The Minefield edition features metal rivet detailing.
